I am Jorge C. Lucero, a professor of computer science who has folded paper for decades and published on the axiomatics of origami geometry. This site is where origami meets mathematics: models with an idea behind them, the theory and history of folding, and origami at work in science and engineering. There are also [free online books](books/index.qmd) in progress, my [papers](publications/index.qmd), and reviews of [origami books](reviews/books/index.qmd) and [origami-inspired products](reviews/products/index.qmd).
